02

03

BEFORE WE BEGIN

A few good questions.

How much will my project cost?

Every project has its own scope. Share your goals, deliverables, timeline, and budget range, and we can discuss an appropriate production approach and quote.

Can you edit footage I already have?

Yes. Tell us about the footage, the story you want to tell, and the finished formats you need. We’ll discuss the files and what’s possible before agreeing on the edit.

Do I need a finished concept?

No. A goal, an audience, or even a rough idea is a good place to start. Creative development can be part of the project.

What if I need content for several platforms?

Let us know where the work will appear. Horizontal, vertical, square, long-form, and shorter versions can be discussed and included in the project scope.

Where do you work?

JHG is based in the Triangle area of North Carolina, serving Raleigh, Durham, and Chapel Hill. Share your location when you inquire so we can discuss travel or remote post-production.
